items.title_orig: Is Chris Stapleton just country music’s Damian Lillard?
items.article_text:
Caught the Chris Stapleton show at Providence Park in Portland last night (great show, really got to see the tape on him), and it got me thinking: is he the Dame Lillard of the music industry?
 Stapleton has total locker-room respect from the rest of the league. His solo acoustic sets are the musical equivalent of Dame Time. He’s a definitive Top-7 guy at his apex, but never claimed the best-guy-in-the-league crown.
 Any other country musician/NBA comps? After the break we’ll hit the Morgan Wallen/James Harden piece, but first, Pearl Jam.
